riskNotes.note: Agent-supplied `config` with an absolute-path `extends` executed arbitrary JS in 0.1.3; fixed in 0.1.4. Verified by execution (lint_solidity, absolute path) and at source (array, solhint:../, plugins, fix_solidity). Unchanged in 0.1.5.

Linting a repository runs that repository's own Solhint plugins and JS config (.solhint.json plugins, .solhintrc.js, solhint.config.js, a project-installed Solhint): the same trust as running `npx solhint` there. No version of this component changes that; it is not safe for untrusted repositories.

Does not report whether the lint fully ran: a plugin that fails to load or an unknown rule name degrades silently, and get_config shows '✅ … recommended checks' whenever three named rules are on, whatever else is broken.
